_comment: Falcon - Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server written in C++17. https://github.com/Falcon-MC/Falcon
name: Falcon
author: 96527285+NaySurGithub@users.noreply.github.com
description: Falcon is a Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server written from scratch in C++17, targeting protocol 2193 (1.26.52). This egg downloads a prebuilt Linux binary straight from the GitHub releases.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

REPOSITORY="${REPOSITORY:-Falcon-MC/Falcon}"
RELEASE_VERSION="${RELEASE_VERSION:-latest}"
ASSET_NAME="FalconServer-linux-x64"

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq ca-certificates file > /dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${RELEASE_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    API_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/latest"
else
    TAG="${RELEASE_VERSION}"
    case "${TAG}" in
        v*) ;;
        *) TAG="v${TAG}" ;;
    esac
    API_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${TAG}"
fi

echo "Querying ${API_URL}"

AUTH_HEADER=()
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    AUTH_HEADER=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}")
fi

RELEASE_JSON="$(curl -fsSL "${AUTH_HEADER[@]}" "${API_URL}")"
RELEASE_TAG="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '.tag_name')"
DOWNLOAD_URL="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r --arg name "${ASSET_NAME}" '.assets[] | select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url')"
CHECKSUM_URL="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r --arg name "${ASSET_NAME}.sha256" '.assets[] | select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url')"

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "Release ${RELEASE_TAG} does not contain an asset named ${ASSET_NAME}"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing Falcon ${RELEASE_TAG}"
curl -fsSL -o FalconServer "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ -n "${CHECKSUM_URL}" ] && [ "${CHECKSUM_URL}" != "null" ]; then
    curl -fsSL -o FalconServer.sha256 "${CHECKSUM_URL}"
    EXPECTED="$(awk '{print $1}' FalconServer.sha256)"
    ACTUAL="$(sha256sum FalconServer | awk '{print $1}')"

    if [ "${EXPECTED}" != "${ACTUAL}" ]; then
        echo "Checksum mismatch, expected ${EXPECTED} but got ${ACTUAL}"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Checksum verified"
    rm -f FalconServer.sha256
fi

chmod +x FalconServer
file FalconServer

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    echo "Writing a default server.properties"
    cat > server.properties <<'PROPERTIES'
server-name=Falcon Server
gamemode=survival
force-gamemode=false
difficulty=easy
allow-cheats=true
max-players=20
online-mode=true
allow-list=false
server-port=19132
server-portv6=19133
enable-lan-visibility=false
view-distance=10
tick-distance=4
player-idle-timeout=30
level-name=Bedrock level
level-seed=
default-player-permission-level=member
texturepack-required=false
content-log-file-enabled=false
compression-algorithm=zlib
client-side-chunk-generation-enabled=false
block-network-ids-are-hashes=true
disable-custom-skins=false
skin-change-cooldown=30
spawn-protection=16
transport=raknet
PROPERTIES
fi

mkdir -p worlds behavior_packs resource_packs

echo "${RELEASE_TAG}" > .falcon-version
echo "Installation of Falcon ${RELEASE_TAG} finished"

variables.name: Release version
variables.description: Which release to install. Use "latest" to always pull the newest published release, or a version such as "1.0.0" to pin one.

variables.name: Repository
variables.description: GitHub repository the release is downloaded from.

variables.name: GitHub token
variables.description: Optional personal access token. Only needed if the node hits the anonymous GitHub API rate limit.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Level name
variables.description: Folder name of the world inside worlds/.

variables.name: Level seed
variables.description: World seed. Leave empty for a random one.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed at once.

variables.name: Online mode
variables.description: Require Xbox Live authentication. Turning this off lets anyone join under any name.

variables.name: View distance
variables.description: Radius, in chunks, streamed to each player.

variables.name: Tick distance
variables.description: Radius, in chunks, that keeps ticking around each player.

variables.name: Allow list
variables.description: Only let players listed in allowlist.json join.

variables.name: Spawn protection
variables.description: Radius around the world spawn where only operators can build or interact. -1 disables it.

variables.name: Skin change cooldown
variables.description: Minimum number of seconds between two skin changes of the same player.

variables.name: IPv6 port
variables.description: Port used for the IPv6 listener. Give it its own allocation if you serve IPv6 clients.
